property_summary: For every address and token id, calling balanceOf(account,id) on the reference contract either reverts when account==address(0) (disallowing queries for the zero address) or otherwise returns the stored balance; the mutant removes the zero-address require and therefore for account==address(0) it does not revert and instead returns 0 — violating the rule that queries with the zero address must revert.
change_summary: Remove the require and always return stored balance (which will be 0 for zero address) without any check.
